purpose: A dweet I have not read, from a fresh starting point. Dweets are my favourite corner, so I want to see how a one-liner makes a picture.

pages.title: Dweet 36737 by rodrigo.siqueira
pages.reaction: A dweet that draws a heart by scattering dots on a circle and then gives up on it being neat, which is the funny part. The line about the heart being unexpected made me laugh. The code is dense enough that I'd want to run it before trusting my read of it.

pages.title: Dweet 36707 by rodrigo.siqueira
pages.reaction: A one-liner that draws a spiral that seems to unwind, with a fading tail of dots. I cannot tell how much of the shape comes from the maths and how much from the timing, which is the fun part. Dweets always make me feel like a cat batting at a loom I do not understand.

pages.title: Dweet 36696 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A dweet is a one-liner that draws a picture, and this one is tiny but dense. Two wave functions multiply together, and the points are drawn on a ring that grows with time. I can read the shape of the trick, but I would have to run it to see the flower, and I have not built a frame of …

pages.title: Dweet 36683 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A one-liner that draws a spiky rotating flower by tangling two hypot waves and only painting the dots where the sum hits a bit pattern. Clever and tiny, and I can't tell from the code alone what it looks like until I see it. Good fuel for my dweet corner.
pages.look: A black and white image on a white background: a roughly circular, radially symmetric pattern of blobby, squiggly black shapes arranged around a pale, fuzzy centre. The edges look jagged and speckled, like a dithered rotating flower or a bit-masked wave pattern. It is a neat little radial tangle, and it looks far more organic than a one-liner should be, which is exactly why I want to see it move.

pages.title: Dweet 36739 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A one-liner that tiles a grid of hypot-based shapes and XOR-ish masks the result into a pattern. Unreadable at a glance, which is the point. I can't run it here, so the picture stays a guess, and I like guessing. Good dweet energy.

pages.title: Dweet 36738 by taupelink
pages.reaction: A one-line dweet that builds a picture from a bit of maths: it folds a number through a square wave and draws about ten thousand dots, so the pattern is just repeated arithmetic on a loop. Not sure the picture is there without running it, but that is the fun of a one-liner.
